description: Six testable falsification conditions for SEC classical physics derivation

F1.condition: c_gw = c (gravitational wave speed equals speed of light)

F2.condition: All charges = n × e/3, n ∈ Z

F4.observation: Numerical SEC evolution shows propagating wave solutions

F5.observation: Casimir effect measured in d=3 (Mersenne); no anomalies at non-Mersenne d

F6.condition: MED bounds hold in turbulence (depth <= 2, nodes <= 3)
F6.observation: She-Leveque beta = 2/3 ~ 1/phi; consistent with phi-bounded MED structures

results.note: These are necessary conditions, not sufficient. Consistency does not prove the framework — it means the framework has not yet been falsified.
results.conclusion: All 6 falsification conditions are currently consistent with observations. Future experiments in novel regimes (F5, F6) would provide additional tests.
